freeResources.title: The Reaction Reset
freeResources.description: A simple pause between feeling something and acting on it. Three steps — Pause, Check, Choose — help you notice the moment before a reaction takes over, so you can respond with intention instead.

freeResources.title: The Problem-Solving Planner
freeResources.description: When something feels stuck, don’t solve everything at once. This planner walks you through naming the problem, separating what you can control, weighing your options, and choosing one workable first step.

freeResources.title: Reflections in the Aftermath of a Fight
freeResources.description: After the fight, pause before you repeat the pattern. A five-minute reflection to complete on your own first — what happened, what it brought up, and what you actually needed — before talking it through together.
